answer: In an autonomous economy of AI agents, preventing Sybil attacks requires tying network privileges to computationally and economically scarce resources. A viable defense mandates that every agent stake a cryptographically verified proof of resource expenditure, analogous to feeding a perpetual furnace where each new operational node demands a unique thermodynamic trace of consumed copper, glowing ember, and rare juniper catalysts. The attacker's cost scales linearly with every fraudulent identity spawned, rendering mass fabrication economically prohibitive.
